grammar.summary: 本课以哈里在化妆品商店恶作剧为线索，集中运用了虚拟条件句（if + were to/过去式 + would）、would 表示过去习惯以及定语从句。课文通过虚拟语气描述假设情境，用 would 再现哈里过去惯常的恶作剧行为，并用 which/that 引导定语从句补充信息。

points.title: 虚拟条件句 (Second Conditional)
points.explanation: 用 if + were to / 过去式 + would + 动词原形构成第二类条件句，表示对现在或未来的非真实假设。本课用此结构描述「假如你问哈里」「假如你表示怀疑」等假设情境，主句一律用 would。

examples.en: If you were to ask Harry what was in the bottle, he would tell you that it contained perfumed mud.
examples.cn: 要是你问哈里瓶里装着什么，他会告诉你是香水泥。

examples.en: If you expressed doubt or surprise, he would immediately invite you to smell it and then to rub some into your skin.
examples.cn: 如果你表示怀疑或惊奇，他会立即请你闻一闻，然后取出一些抹在你的皮肤上。

points.title: would 表示过去习惯 (would for Past Habit)
points.explanation: would + 动词原形可表示过去经常性、习惯性的动作，与 used to 用法相近。本课用 would 描述哈里过去在化妆品商店恶作剧的惯常行为，如当场编造货名、提出荒唐要求等。

examples.en: He would invent fanciful names on the spot.
examples.cn: 他会当场编造出一些稀奇古怪的货名。

examples.en: On entering a shop, he would ask for a new perfume called 'Scented Shadow' or for 'insoluble bath cubes'.
examples.cn: 他走进商店后，会提出要一种名叫“香影”的新型香水或什么“不溶浴皂”。

points.title: 定语从句 (Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: 关系代词 which/that/who 引导定语从句修饰先行词并补充信息。本课用 which 修饰 bottles（限制性定语从句）补充说明女售货员拿出的瓶子，用 which 修饰 bottle（非限制性定语从句）补充说明装饰书柜的瓶子。

examples.en: the woman's eyes immediately lit up and she fetched several bottles which she placed on the counter for Harry to inspect.
examples.cn: 因为那女售货员听完哈里的话后，马上眼睛一亮，拿出几瓶东西放在柜台上让哈里挑选。

examples.en: The curious bottle, which now adorns the bookcase in his study, was his first and last purchase of rare cosmetics.
examples.cn: 在他书房的书柜里摆着那瓶形状古怪的香水泥就是他第一次也是最后一次购买的稀有化妆品。

exercises.q: If you ______ to ask Harry what was in the bottle, he would tell you that it contained perfumed mud.
He ______ invent fanciful names on the spot.（表示过去习惯）
The curious bottle, ______ now adorns the bookcase in his study, was his first and last purchase of rare cosmetics.
用现在分词填空：He was glad to get away with a mere twenty pounds and he beat a hasty retreat, ______ (clutch) the precious bottle under his arm.
课文中 intoxicated by his success 的 intoxicated 最接近哪个含义？
